How tall is the human pyramid in feet? Nine out of ten cheerleaders are 64 inches tall. The tenth cheerleader is 60 inches tall. The human pyramid has 4 girls on the bottom, 3 girls standing on top of the 4, and 2 girls standing on top of the 3. The shortest girl is at the top of the human pyramid.
